title: DR reflection plan: testing layer (53 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the testing layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

evidence.quote: The relationships composes and depends-on from testing.coveragerequirement to testing.outcomecategory are redundant. Proposed: Keep one relationship between CoverageRequirement and OutcomeCategory and remove the other.

OutcomeCategory relationships belong to the TestCoverageTarget rather than to the CoverageRequirement, so the composes and depends-on relationships to outcomecategory are misplaced. Proposed: Move the outcome category association to TestCoverageTarget and remove it from CoverageRequirement.
